title: Crisp mornings, warm studio
headline: Crisp mornings, warm studio
detail: Your reformer is waiting this week
caption:
Frost on the car, mist over Pendle, and a cup of tea that goes cold too quickly. Mid-November in the Ribble Valley. ❄️

This is the time of year bodies get stiff and the sofa gets very tempting.

An hour on the reformer is the antidote. You'll leave warm, a little taller, and properly awake, ready for the rest of the week.

New or coming back after a break? A single Reformer class is £18, and every class can be adapted to your level.

This week's reformer Pilates classes in Clitheroe are open to book through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
source: Monthly themes: Nov 2026 (Strength for every body; Reformer). Weekly rhythm: Monday week ahead. Playbook: sense of place + one reason to book + price. Known price: £18 single class.
